ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #13
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on: responsibility? (1 mark)
   A. Say Hadith on: responsibility has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Hadith on: responsibility with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on: responsibility.
   D. Use Hadith on: responsibility to insult classmates of other faiths.

   D. Say Hadith on:Ihsaan 4.0 HADITH (Traditions of has no place in daily life.

7. Which response best shows understanding of care for plants? (1 mark)
   A. Use care for plants to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing care for plants.
   C. Apply the teaching of care for plants with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say care for plants has no place in daily life.

8. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Cheating in exams
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Spreading rumours
   D. Hiding stolen items

9. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on:Honesty? (1 mark)
   A. Say Hadith on:Honesty has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Hadith on:Honesty to insult classmates of other faiths.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Relationship 6.2.1 care and dua for the sick? (1 mark)

13. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Waste food daily
   D. Care for the environment and use resources wisely

14. Which response best shows understanding of Believe in? (1 mark)

   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Believe in.
   C. Apply the teaching of Believe in with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

15. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Refusing to help a neighbour
   B. Skipping all moral lessons
   C. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   D. Mocking other people’s beliefs
